title: New Developments in the Capital Market: MiniMax Officially Included in the Hong Kong Stock Connect, Stock Price Surged Over 10%

content_html:
With the latest round of adjustments to the list of stocks eligible for Hong Kong stock connect, the artificial intelligence sector has once again received positive news. On August 5th, the market announced the new list of stocks added to the Hong Kong stock connect, and the relevant adjustments will take effect starting the next day. This news boosted the performance of the related stocks in the capital market. By the end of the day, the Hong Kong stock of MiniMax rose more than 10%.

In addition to the positive developments on the capital front, the company has also been active in the field of technology research and development. This week, MiniMax officially open-sourced its new general-purpose multimodal generation model MiniMax H3.

Thanks to its outstanding technical performance, the model has achieved impressive results in industry authoritative evaluations. According to the information, it has now ranked first in both the Artificial Analysis video editing evaluation list and the Arena image-to-video ranking list, demonstrating strong industry competitiveness and technical application capabilities.

content_html_zh:
随着最新一轮港股通股票名单调整，人工智能板块再次传来利好消息。 8月5日，市场公布了新加入港股通的股票名单，相关调整将于次日起生效。 此消息提振了资本市场相关个股的表现。 截至收盘，MiniMax港股涨幅超过10%。

除了资本方面的积极进展外，公司在技术研发领域也表现活跃。 本周，MiniMax 正式开源其全新通用多式联运一代车型 MiniMax H3。

凭借出色的技术性能，该车型在行业权威评测中取得了骄人的成绩。 据了解，目前在Artificial Analysis视频编辑评测榜单和Arena图像转视频排行榜上均排名第一，展现出强大的行业竞争力和技术应用能力。
